description.value: Island 22 Regional Park is a Fraser Valley Regional District nature reserve situated along the Fraser River near Chilliwack, at the area historically known as Island 22 where the Chilliwack River meets the Fraser. The park offers a natural riverside environment popular for walking, wildlife viewing, and off-leash dog areas. For touring cyclists, it provides a scenic natural detour in the agricultural flatlands east of Chilliwack.
